environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-http extension. Split.io SDK initialized with API key targeting 'api-service-prod' identity. The flag 'graphql.legacy-dynamic-query' has treatment 'on' for all environments in the current Split workspace (set during emergency rollback in sprint 47 and never reverted). PostgreSQL 14 backend accessible via RDS within the same VPC. No query-level firewall or input sanitization middleware configured.

config.network: Lambda in VPC, direct RDS access on port 5432
